scope: One instrumented cost diagnostic only; not a new performance row or a method comparison. No algorithm change, main experiment, holdout or expansion.

diagnostic.purpose: Measure disjoint Python cost buckets and per-selected-leg work/outcomes to choose routing-cost vs pre-route-bound work. Existing full 120s Strong/Scale rows remain the performance evidence.
diagnostic.restrictions: Exactly one profiled worker; no automatic retries, method expansion, time-limit extension or solver-informed domain changes.
